missingPoints: 30 preload IPC invoke calls carry TODO type-guard comments — no runtime validation of IPC responses

listStyleSheets, snapshotThemeDom, snapshotBaseline, captureLiveDom, listStudioProjects, createStudioProject, saveStudioProject, importStudioProject, loadStudioSnapshot, getVisualAnalysisTarget, listVisualAnalysisTargets, listVisualAnalysisSummaries, detectVisualAnalysisAgent, exportVisualAnalysisTheme, extractThemeFromImage, listBundles, listWallpapersForStudio, getPerformanceTimeouts, getPerformanceHistory, getPerformanceMemory, triggerManualRegen, probeSelector, validateSelectors, getMcpStatus all lack type-guards
InjectionHealthMonitor singleton (injectionHealthMonitor) is exported but never imported or used anywhere outside its own test file
No integration with notificationStore or statusStore — onFailure callback is never wired to surface user-facing notifications
No integration with themeStore or apply flow — reInjectFn is never connected to the actual theme re-apply logic
Effectively dead code: the live health monitoring path uses theme-health-check.ts + cdp-fingerprint.ts drift detection instead
pushDriftStatus only sends THEME_DRIFT_STATUS to mainWindow — studioWindow is not notified
Breaks the fan-out pattern established by notifyStatusChanged/notifyPersistFailure/sendDeepLinkToRenderer which all send to both windows
THEME_HEALTH_REPORT is only pushed to mainWindow — studioWindow does not receive health reports
Breaks the dual-window fan-out pattern; Studio's capture-store subscribes to onThemeHealthReport but will never get updates
THEME_ENGINE_INJECT_FAILURE is only sent to mainWindow — studioWindow is not notified of engine injection failures
Inconsistent with the dual-window fan-out pattern used by other critical notifications
BUNDLE_OPEN_FILE IPC handler is registered (ipcMain.handle) but never invoked from preload.ts — no renderer-facing API exists
handleThemeFileOpen in main-context.ts calls installBundleFromPath directly, bypassing the BUNDLE_OPEN_FILE channel entirely
The channel is dead code — registered but unreachable from the renderer
FILE_IMPORTED event after bundle install is only sent to mainWindow — studioWindow does not receive it
Inconsistent with the dual-window pattern; Studio's theme list may go stale after a bundle install
disposeSecondaryInjectSubscriptions is exported and called from renderer.tsx beforeunload, but no HMR dispose hook exists
@todo comment acknowledges the gap — subscription leaks can occur across HMR reloads
init() has an _initialized guard but dispose does not reset it, so re-init after dispose would be a no-op
restoreAll() catches per-agent restore errors individually (survives a failing restore) but does NOT implement transaction rollback — partial restore leaves system in inconsistent state
No notification to the user when some agents fail and others succeed — failures are silently swallowed
No integration with notificationStore to surface partial-failure results

notifyPersistFailure sends PERSIST_FAILURE_WARNING to both windows (correct fan-out) but the renderer-side handler in useAppController only updates diagnosticsStore — no user-facing toast or alert is shown
The IPC channel comment says 'Renderer subscribes via preload and shows a destructive toast' but the actual implementation only increments a counter in diagnosticsStore

environmentStore.switchEnvironment applies theme + wallpaper but does NOT subscribe to settingsStore changes — if the user changes app path/port while an environment is active, the environment is not re-applied
No cross-store subscription to settingsStore for reactive re-apply when agent configuration changes
environmentStore.purgeTheme removes presets but does not notify settingsStore or trigger a status refresh
settingsStore mutations (setRadiusScale, setDensity, setMotion, setCustomThemeCss) only update localStorage + state — no cross-module notification is emitted
No SETTINGS_CHANGED IPC event or callback to notify themeStore/wallpaperStore/shellStore that settings have changed
Other stores must poll or re-read settings via api.getSettings() rather than being pushed updates
refreshMcpStatus silently ignores errors — MCP start failure is not surfaced to the user through notificationStore
toggleMcp surfaces errors via notificationStore.fail but the mcpRunning/mcpUrl state is only visible in SettingsPage — no global status indicator for MCP connection state

sendDeepLinkToRenderer correctly fans out to both windows, but the renderer-side handling of deep link events (apply-result, apply-error, restore) is not wired to notificationStore for user-facing feedback
handleRestore does not send any result event back to the renderer — the UI cannot show success/failure for restore deep links
detectOverriddenVariables has a TODO type-guard comment — the JSON.parse(raw) result is cast as OverriddenVariable[] without runtime validation
No integration with notificationStore to alert the user when theme variables are being overridden by the host app

wallpaperStore→themeStore companion flow (runWallpaperCompanion) calls api.applyTheme directly but does not wire into the full apply-flow error handling — failures are only reported via notificationStore
No rollback mechanism: if theme apply succeeds but wallpaper re-apply fails, the system is left in an inconsistent state
Zero test coverage — no dreamskin-parser.test.ts exists in the entire codebase
Parser correctness for DreamSkin ZIP packages is entirely unverified
Zero test coverage — no agentskin-built-parser.test.ts exists
The identity parser used for re-importing exported themes and built-in themes is unverified
Zero test coverage — no source-directory-parser.test.ts exists
The catch-all parser for raw source theme directories is unverified
Zero test coverage for engines/shared/ adoption-sheets-manager.mjs
Core CDP injection infrastructure (adoptedStyleSheets management) has no unit tests
Zero test coverage for engines/shared/ deep-core.mjs
DeepCore (Shadow DOM + route handling) is a critical injection layer with no unit tests
Zero test coverage for engines/shared/ token-discovery.mjs
Token discovery (CSS variable extraction from target pages) is unverified
injection-feedback.test.mjs exists but only covers basic feedback reporting — no integration tests with health-monitor or drift detection
No test coverage for the feedback→notificationStore integration path

agent-engine-service.ts has 8 dedicated test files (apply-integration, core-reliability, metrics, persist-visibility, reliability, restore-integration, wallpaper-integration, wallpaper-resolution) — good coverage
However, the test files mock most sub-modules; the actual integration between apply→wallpaper→health-check is not tested end-to-end
restoreAll transaction rollback is tested only for survival of errors, not for consistency of final state
